verdict: Paid campaigns went dark August 6; leads have paused with them.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns stopped spending on August 6 and have not resumed — 12 consecutive days with zero spend and zero new leads. Importantly, the campaigns were not underperforming before they paused: over the full 28 days you received 45 leads at a cost per lead of $26.04, a rate that was holding steady. Organic search traffic and Google Business Profile engagement have since softened, which is expected when paid activity goes quiet and brand search drops with it. Campaigns are being reactivated now, and you should see lead volume resume within the first days of the coming week.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all from Meta before the pause
cost per lead at the point campaigns stopped — a working rate, not an efficiency problem
consecutive days with no paid spend or new leads as of today

watch_item.issue: Meta campaigns have been dark since August 6, cutting off all paid lead flow.
watch_item.fix: Campaigns are being reactivated this week to restore spend and lead volume at the prior rate.
